{{Quote|Not much worse they can do to us, is there?|Phytus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Phytus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the small military force of the [[Isen Four mining colony|mining colony]] located on [[Isen IV]] asteroid during the [[Galactic War]]. The colony willingly surrendered to the representatives of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but was met with hostilities nonetheless. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Cipher Agent|Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] later discovered that the massacre in the colony was in fact caused not by the Empire, but by [[Star Cabal]] Agent [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]], who was pitting the Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against each other while pretending to play for both sides as suitable.
